https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/riNlAkYbcW3g92VRLqq0?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_id }}&stage=s5_gate

Thank you for being part of {{ custom_values.anthology_name }}.

Warmly,
The Editors
